title: Software Engineer

text:
Software Engineer
Kaveri Systems | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a software engineer to join our software engineering team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Microservices
- Python
- AWS
- System Design
- Java
- 3+ years of experience in software engineering

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Git
- GraphQL
- SQL
- Kubernetes

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive payment reconciliation automation with measurable outcomes.
- Drive internal developer tooling with measurable outcomes.
- Drive customer onboarding platform delivery with measurable outcomes.
